LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 13.3.1 WH- QUESTIONS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Language Use 13.3.1 Wh- questions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 13.3.1 Wh- questions, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: How do we ask for information?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 13.3.1 Wh- questions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration -by engaging in meaningful question and answer dialogues using Wh-words in pairs/small groups.

• Self-efficacy- is developed as learners gain the mastery of asking questions using the Wh- words.

Values:
Unity and respect - as learners take turns during dialogues.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Citizenship (social cohesion)- as learners work in groups

• Life skills (effective communication) -as learners learn to ask and answer questions.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Kiswahili and Indigenous Languages Activities-Learners engage in question and answer sessions using the Wh-words.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital devices

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
